<p>In <a href="/cloudflare-for-platforms/cloudflare-for-saas/saas-customers/how-it-works/">Orange-to-Orange (O2O)</a> setups — where a SaaS provider uses <a href="/cloudflare-for-platforms/cloudflare-for-saas/">Cloudflare for SaaS</a> and their customer also has their own Cloudflare zone — the <code>__cf_bm</code> Bot Management cookie returned from the origin-facing Cloudflare zone can cause the eyeball-facing zone to bypass cache. This occurs because the <code>Set-Cookie</code> header in the response triggers Cloudflare's default behavior of not caching responses with <code>Set-Cookie</code>.</p>
<p>If you are seeing unexpectedly low cache hit rates in an O2O setup with Bot Management enabled, this may be the cause.</p>
